topologies.title: Council
topologies.label: 01  council
topologies.description: Every dot sees the same Mintis and contributes a partial view before a synthesis step.
topologies.failure: consensus theater or too much parallel noise
topologies.human: choose what gets synthesized and what remains unresolved

topologies.title: Maker–Critic
topologies.label: 02  maker–critic
topologies.description: One dot proposes, one challenges, and the artifact loops between them until a stopping condition is met.
topologies.failure: endless critique or defensive local optimization
topologies.human: set the bar and decide when critique has earned its keep

topologies.title: Pipeline
topologies.label: 03  pipeline
topologies.description: Work passes through specialized stages. Each dot transforms the artifact and hands it forward.
topologies.failure: lossy handoffs and brittle dependency on order
topologies.human: inspect boundaries and intervene where context is lost

topologies.title: Star
topologies.label: 04  star
topologies.description: A central coordinator routes the Mintis to specialists and gathers their results.
topologies.failure: coordinator bottleneck and hidden central bias
topologies.human: inspect routing choices and override delegation

topologies.title: Peer Network
topologies.label: 05  peer network
topologies.description: Dots exchange partial views directly. No single node owns the whole state.
topologies.human: shape incentives, permissions, and stopping conditions

topologies.title: Lens Stack
topologies.label: 06  lens stack
topologies.description: The same object is inspected through distinct lenses that should not collapse into one universal judge.
topologies.produces: legibility of difference and multi-perspective critique
topologies.failure: false synthesis or one lens dominating the others
topologies.human: keep perspectives distinct long enough to reveal what one view misses
